paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: PaLM 540B sets a new state-of-the-art result in 1-shot and few-shot settings for the Winogender coreference task, with accuracy improving as model scale increases.

evidence.quote: accuracy on the Winogender coreference task improves with model scale, and PaLM 540B sets a new state-of-the-art result in 1-shot and few-shot settings
